snippet.title: Hot Wheels Unleashed - DC Super Heroes Racing Season | PS5, PS4
snippet.description: The wait is over! The HOT WHEELS™ - DC Super Heroes Racing Season is finally here! From today to June 14th clear the way (and space in your collection) for the DC Super Heroes and their super vehicles, unlock free and premium items and get gear ad coins by proving your strength with these super fun challenges! What are you waiting for? Get it now!
